newsHighlights.title: Alibaba order highlights firms' challenges in US
newsHighlights.summary: A US court granted Alibaba a preliminary injunction barring the government from denying Pentagon contracts solely because of companies' parentage.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国法院初步裁定支持阿里巴巴，禁止政府仅因母公司背景而拒绝向相关企业授予五角大楼合同。

newsHighlights.title: China voices concerns over EU trade curbs
newsHighlights.summary: China expressed concern over the EU's new trade restrictions, saying they have hurt industrial and supply chain stability and bilateral ties.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国对欧盟新出台的贸易限制措施表示关切，指出这些措施损害了产业链、供应链稳定及双边关系。

newsHighlights.title: A look at China's economic data in first three quarters of 2026
newsHighlights.summary: China's key economic indicators for the first three quarters of 2026 point to steady growth backed by domestic demand and innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 2026年前三季度中国经济数据显示，在内需与创新驱动下，经济保持稳健增长。

newsHighlights.title: Jan-Sept growth driven by opening-up
newsHighlights.summary: China's growth from January to September was largely driven by wider opening-up, attracting foreign investment and boosting trade.
newsHighlights.translation: 1至9月中国经济增长主要由更高水平对外开放驱动，吸引外资并促进贸易。

newsHighlights.title: How China's innovation fuels global progress
newsHighlights.summary: China's innovation in manufacturing and green technology is contributing to global productivity and sustainable development.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国在制造业与绿色科技领域的创新正为全球生产率和可持续发展作出贡献。

quote.quote: In business, the competition will bite you if you keep running; if you stand still, they will swallow you.
quote.author: William Wrigley Jr.
quote.translation: 在商场上，你若不停奔跑，竞争者只会咬你一口；你若原地踏步，他们就会把你吞没。
quote.explanation: 这句话强调商业竞争中持续进取的重要性，正如今日新闻中的中国企业，只有不断创新、拓展市场，才能在复杂的国际环境中保持竞争力。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻正文：a preliminary injunction（初步强制令）。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「China voices concerns over EU trade curbs」。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻正文：...and bilateral（ties）（双边关系）。

vocabulary.example: Supply chain stability is vital for global businesses.
vocabulary.translation: 供应链稳定对全球企业至关重要。

vocabulary.example: China's economy maintained growth momentum in the first three quarters.

pattern.pattern: A has expressed concern over B, noting that C ...（A 对 B 表示关切，并指出 C……）
pattern.example: China has expressed concern over the European Union's recent push to introduce trade restrictions, noting that such measures have adversely affected industrial and supply chain stability.
pattern.translation: 中国对欧盟近期推动出台贸易限制措施表示关切，并指出此类措施已对产业链和供应链稳定造成不利影响。
pattern.usage: 常用于正式新闻与商务写作：先陈述立场（expressed concern/interest/confidence over...），再用 noting that... 引出具体理由或依据。可替换为 adding that / pointing out that。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻英语中的运用
grammar.explanation: 新闻报道常用「have/has + 过去分词」来强调发生在过去但对现在仍有影响的事件，或事件结果仍然有效。常与 already, just, recently, so far 等时间副词连用。若明确给出过去时间点，则改用一般过去时。
examples: Such measures have adversely affected industrial and supply chain stability.
China has expressed concern over the European Union's recent push to introduce trade restrictions.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二音节 -dʒʌŋk-。首音节读轻 /ɪn/；/dʒ/ 为破擦音，舌尖先抵上齿龈再弹开；-ction 读 /kʃn/，/ʃ/ 要圆唇送气，结尾是成音节 /n/，不要读成「in-junk-tion」。
examples: The court granted the company a preliminary injunction.
An injunction was issued to protect the firm's legal rights.

reading.title: Chinese Firms Face Legal Hurdles in the US Market
reading.content:
Chinese companies expanding overseas are meeting growing legal and regulatory hurdles in the United States. On Wednesday, Alibaba Group won a preliminary injunction from a US court, which ordered the government not to deny Pentagon contracts to firms solely because of their parent companies. The ruling highlights both the opportunities and the challenges Chinese businesses face abroad.

Meanwhile, trade frictions remain a concern. China has expressed concern over the European Union's push for new trade restrictions, noting that such measures have adversely affected industrial and supply chain stability and bilateral ties. Experts say open markets and fair rules benefit all sides.

At home, China's economy has maintained steady momentum. Data from the first three quarters of 2026 shows growth driven by wider opening-up, innovation and rising domestic demand — a solid foundation for businesses planning their next move.
reading.translation:
拓展海外市场的中国企业在美国正面临越来越多的法律与监管障碍。周三，阿里巴巴集团获得美国法院的初步强制令，法院要求政府不得仅因母公司的缘故就拒绝向企业授予五角大楼合同。这一裁决既凸显了中国企业出海的机遇，也揭示了挑战。

与此同时，贸易摩擦仍令人担忧。中国对欧盟推动出台新的贸易限制措施表示关切，指出这些措施已对产业链、供应链稳定和双边关系造成不利影响。专家表示，开放的市场和公平的规则对各方都有利。

在国内，中国经济保持稳健增长势头。2026年前三季度数据显示，增长由更高水平对外开放、创新和内需扩大共同驱动——这为企业规划下一步发展奠定了坚实基础。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 2026-10-29 报道「Alibaba order highlights firms' challenges in US」「China voices concerns over EU trade curbs」「A look at China's economic data in first three quarters of 2026」及「Jan-Sept growth driven by opening-up」改写，专为英语学习设计。
